subject: [PATCH 2/3] zstd: skip the BMI2 probe when dynamic BMI2 dispatch is disabled

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch modifies the zstd library to skip the BMI2 probe when dynamic BMI2 dispatch is disabled. This change prevents unnecessary CPUID instructions from being issued, which can be serializing on x86 architectures. The modification adds a conditional check within the ZSTD_cpuSupportsBmi2 function to only perform the probe if DYNAMIC_BMI2 is enabled.
